description: Reassemble ISO-TP (ISO 15765-2) messages from CAN frames, per CAN id, and decode each as UDS. Reports frame types (SF/FF/CF/FC), flow-control BS/STmin, sequence-number errors, interrupted messages, padding, and N_Bs/N_Cr/STmin timing warnings when timestamps (ms) are given. Accepts a frame list or a candump text dump.

decodeUds.description: Decode each reassembled message as UDS (default true).

frames.description: Array of {id, data, t?} (id hex string or number, data hex string or byte array, t in ms), or a candump-style multiline string.

padding.description: true: warn on unpadded short frames; false: warn when padding bytes appear.

name: decode_isotp
title: Decode ISO-TP trace
